description: Monitor a pull request through review and CI until it's green: verify every bot claim against the code, fix what's real, push back on what's wrong, rerun flaky checks. Use when the user asks to babysit, monitor, watch, or shepherd a PR, says "get this PR green" or "handle the review comments". Accepts an optional PR number/URL; defaults to the current branch's open PR.
